rubric.unit: One current upstream Ax skill section paired with complete corresponding unified reference sections and the master routing contract. Includes the previous unified reference as the density-regression baseline.

coverage.instructions: Compare every actionable source requirement, boundary, example intent, URL and scope with supplied unified counterpart. Allow terse equivalent organization and obsolete installed-skill names replaced with local references. Explicitly documented upstream contradictions are preserved provenance, not automatic destination defects. Metadata standalone names consolidate into ax-skills. Never infer newer APIs.

criteria.covered: All actionable source facts are accurately retained or an explicit evidenced correction explains the difference.
criteria.missing: At least one actionable source fact is absent from the unified counterpart.
criteria.incorrect: A unified statement contradicts an actionable source fact without evidenced correction.
criteria.mixed: Both omissions and unevidenced contradictions occur.
criteria.other: The source unit is only organizational or metadata with no independent actionable fact.

density_regression.instructions: Does the UPDATE introduce unnecessary duplicated instructions or filler compared with the supplied previous unified reference? Evaluate only added/changed unified prose. Unchanged prose, distinct examples, schema representations, explicit upstream-conflict notes and necessary cross-topic scope boundaries are not a regression. If the only change is source-version metadata, answer false.

rubric.prefilter: Exclude non-Ax skills and blank sections only; include every Markdown section under original ax-prefixed skills.
rubric.escalation: Inspect every non-covered coverage verdict, top probability below0.7, density_regression probability>=0.5, error or truncation. All previous rubric verdicts are superseded and not used as current acceptance evidence.

superseded_rubric.reason: Whole-existing-reference density review exceeds upgrade-regression scope; rubric replaced and every unit re-judged. All verdicts from this run invalidated and excluded from acceptance evidence.

passes.note: Complete replacement-rubric pass before final actor routing correction.

routing_cases.task: Orient me to the Ax library factories and the broad application-building workflow.
Configure ai() provider model routing with adaptive balancing and embeddings.
Implement Gemini Live conversational audio and inspect voice and transcript formats.
Build a fluent f() signature with constrained fields and Standard Schema input validation.
Use AxGen streaming assertions and field processors for structured output.
Build agent() with child agents and a clarification handler using ordinary core tools.
Choose between contextMap, contextPolicy, memories, dynamic skills, and persistent task learning.
Implement recall() using relevance-ranked memory catalogs and dynamically discover agent skills.
Configure AxJSRuntime contextFields and llmQuery recursionOptions for sandbox execution.
Attribute AxAgent usage to tenants with axGlobals.onUsage, usageContext and actor callbacks.
Evaluate and tune agent.optimize() with judgeOptions and restore optimizedProgram artifacts.
Compose a flow() DAG with conditional routing, parallel nodes and map-reduce.
Persist eventRuntime state and explicitly wake or resume an Ax program after ingestion.
Run global AxGEPA multi-objective Pareto optimization on validation examples.
Maintain an evolving AxPlaybook using ACE offline evolve() and online update().
Select per-call samples with bestOfN or refine rewards, thresholds and attempt diagnostics.
Attach an AxMCPClient with OAuth, resources, tasks, subscription recording and replay.
Use Typesafe Jev native Noul/Choice/Score evidence and probability-based classification in TypeScript.
Configure GPT-6.1 Sol reasoning effort, breakpoint cache TTL and Standard/Flex/Priority cost accounting.
Interpret OpenAI Responses terminal incomplete status and Anthropic cumulative message_delta input/cache/output usage, including zero counts.
Localize a target using Jev1.14 PNG/JPEG image input: experimental header, asset references, dimensions and size limits.
Declare f.box().withEvidence(), validate normalized AxBox geometry, and round-trip quoted signature descriptions.
Understand actor multiple fenced-code rejection for structured JSON and CRLF line endings.
